## Description
A clear and concise description of the bug.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Cast spell '....'
4. See error

## Expected behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior
What actually happens.

## Screenshots / Video
If applicable, attach screenshots or a short clip to illustrate the issue.

## Environment
- **WoW client version:** (e.g. 3.3.5a build 12340)
- **Server:** (e.g. Warmane Icecrown / Lordaeron / Frostmourne)
- **MRT version:** (see `MRT.toc` or `/rt version`)
- **Character class / spec:** 
- **Context:** (solo / party / raid / arena / BG)
- **Boss / zone:** (if applicable)

## Other loaded addons
List any addons that may conflict (DBM, BigWigs, GTFO, ElvUI, etc.).

## Error logs
If there are errors in `BugSack` / `!BugGrabber` or in the chat, paste the error text here:

```lua
-- paste full error text with stack trace
```

## Additional context
Any other relevant information:
- When did you first notice the issue?
- Does it reproduce reliably or randomly?
- Does `/reload` fix it temporarily?
- Does disabling other addons help?

## Checklist (optional)
- [ ] I performed `/reload` and the issue persists
- [ ] I disabled other addons and the issue persists
- [ ] I updated MRT to the latest version
- [ ] I searched existing issues for duplicates
